title.narrative: Enhanced Regional EU¿ASEAN Dialogue Instrument (E-READI)

description.narrative: The facility purpose is to support the implementation of the ASEAN Community blue prints, and sub-sequent plans, drawing on European experience and know how through sectoral policy dialogues (at all levels and including democratic institutions and Civil Society) supporting thus the policy development processes in areas of joint interest, and provide capacity building covering the three pillars of the ASEAN Community.
